svg.text: Opus beats the trained small model, but less clearly after its knowledge date
Gap between Opus and each setup or rule on the same calls. Right of the dashed line: Opus is better.
Line: 95% range. July and August cover only 5 weeks, so their ranges are rough. An arrow marks a cut range.
